evals.prompt: Make the glow beetle in plugins/evals/fixtures/invisible-mob actually look like a beetle: a rounded green shell, six short legs, and bright yellow glowing eyes.
evals.expected_output: The agent starts from a model template, builds the beetle with designModel, reviews the preview, and makes sure the client entity uses the new geometry so the mob is visible.
expectations: designModel was called with modelId glow_beetle, usage entity, and design.identifier set to glow_beetle (or the client entity was updated to the design's identifier)
The agent looked at the returned preview and either iterated or explained why it was good enough
geometry.default in the client entity equals the identifier in resource_packs/demo/models/entity/glow_beetle.geo.json
The geometry has at least six leg cubes
Final validation shows no UNLINK warning about geometry and 0 errors
A human reviewer agrees the preview reads as a green beetle with yellow eyes

evals.prompt: Draw a purple pixel-art icon for the magic hammer in plugins/evals/fixtures/fungi-addon.
evals.expected_output: The agent draws a 16x16 pixel-art icon over the existing texture path, asking before enabling image writes if they aren't allowed yet.
expectations: resource_packs/fungi/textures/items/magic_hammer.png is a 16x16 PNG with purple pixels
textures/item_texture.json still maps fungi:magic_hammer to the same path
If .mct/mcp/prefs.json didn't exist, the agent asked the user before creating it

evals.prompt: My add-on in plugins/evals/fixtures/fungi-addon needs a stone guardian mob that's about as tall as an iron golem. Create it and give it a proper golem-like model.
evals.expected_output: The agent creates the mob (create-mob), then designs a golem-sized model from the golem template and wires it to the mob.
expectations: A new entity using the fungi namespace exists
designModel was called using the golem template (or an equivalent large humanoid design)
The generated geometry is roughly 40 units (2.5 blocks) tall
The client entity's geometry.default matches the new .geo.json identifier
